general.summary: Use for independent PR, diff or branch review; not explanations. Full multi-agent review requires an explicit deep-review request.

general.name: antfu-query
general.summary: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan, decision, or idea until reaching a shared understanding, using the agent's interactive question tool (not plain text). Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking, clarify requirements, or says "grill me" or "query me".

general.name: cleanup-git-worktrees
general.summary: Use for stale-worktree, Git registration and branch audits. Managed removal uses the repo lifecycle.

general.name: desktop-security-update
general.summary: Inspect, mark, or revoke vulnerable LobeHub Desktop versions through the existing release workflow and signed R2 security policy. Use for forced security updates across Stable, Canary, Beta, and Nightly.

general.name: unix-cli-best-practices
general.summary: Safe, portable, and efficient command-line patterns for macOS/BSD Unix tools (grep, find, sed, awk, xargs, mdfind, pbcopy, open) and modern alternatives (ripgrep, fd). Covers common shell scripting and one-liner use cases including fast searching, text processing, codebase navigation, and parallel execution.

general.name: add-setting-env
general.summary: Add server-side environment variables that control default values for user settings.

general.name: agent-runtime-hooks
general.summary: Use for agent lifecycle hooks, tool mocks, intervention, sub-agent calls and context compression.

general.name: design-prototype
general.summary: Use for interactive HTML prototypes (交互原型) with the real LobeHub UI stack. Excludes production UI implementation.

general.name: hotkey
general.summary: Use for keyboard shortcuts, registration, key combinations, scope, conflicts and shortcut tooltips.

general.name: i18n
general.summary: Use for user-facing strings and react-i18next locale keys, namespaces, interpolation, translations or bun run i18n.

general.name: nexent-daily-test
general.summary: 在 Ubuntu 自托管测试机上编排 Nexent 每日分层全量测试、维护本地测试基线和 P0 Playwright 候选代码，并将证据仅保存在本机。用于 OpenCode 执行 Daily/手工全量测试；不用于 PR 测试或外部结果发布。

general.name: debug-frontend-with-browser
general.summary: Use for intermittent UI, stale state, ordering, navigation or browser-only bugs. Extends acceptance with boundary tracing and regression diagnosis.

general.name: agent-work
general.summary: Use for the Agent Work output registry: registration, deduplication, cards, skill providers, CLI scanners and Work types.

general.name: db-migrations
general.summary: Use for Drizzle migration rollout, online indexes, backfills, idempotent SQL and migration regeneration or rebase conflicts.

general.name: debug-package
general.summary: Use for debug() logging, lobe-* namespaces, DEBUG/localStorage.debug configuration and log formatting.
